== Title ==
<span lang="ja">LIN-V8M（エライン・ヴィーエイテム）</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">地雷を敷設できる。また、ターン中の好きな時に、１フォース消費して同じ位置カードにある地雷を１つ“無効化”（ロスト）させられる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">地雷の敷設を専門とする、軍用の装甲ドロイド。元来は鉱脈やスパイス鉱山に爆薬を仕掛けるためのものだが、軍用に改造されている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm)]].

'''Lore''' — An armored military droid that specializes in laying mines. It was originally meant to plant explosives in ore veins and spice mines, but has been converted for military use.

'''Game text''' — May lay mines. Also, at any time during a turn, may use 1 Force to “defuse” (lose) one mine at the same location card.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Printed title is エライン・ヴィーエイテム; the Premiere black-border article reads エンライン・ヴィーエイテム. Lore uses 鉱脈 (ore veins) for ore mines. Game text matches the Light Japanese LIN-V8K face.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-linv8m-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm)]].</ref>
